required_live_checks: Campaign owner confirms selected filenames are not active/current dependencies, required historical replay inputs, active retention restoration sources or scratch21 exclusions.
Privileged independent executor checks fresh inode/type/nlink/uid/mode/size/timestamps/hash stability and root-user openFD/mount/container bind dependencies before exact-file removal.

Preserve all unmatched files/subdirectories, original failed captures, compressed repo archives, Git objects, current FP1e7a image/source/module/toolchain/kmsg work, scratch21 and all lock/exclusion records.
No glob, recursive directory deletion, image resize/delete, reserve changes or trim included. Retained Git blobs are restoration sources.
